# Client reviews and suitability

## Annual review
Every advisory client has a review meeting at least once every 12 months. Before the meeting the adviser checks the date of the client's risk profile. A risk profile older than 12 months is refreshed in the meeting, and the new answers are recorded before any change to the portfolio.

## Cash holdings
Cash above the client's agreed target by more than 10 percentage points is raised with the client at the next review, with the reason the client gave for holding it.

## Suitability notes
A suitability note is written within 2 business days of any recommendation. A recommendation without a note may not be acted on.
